The scenario: Company executive (王某甲) gives cash to county head (王某) to retain the company in the list of retained steel enterprises, after the government decided to close illegal projects. The official helped by inflating high furnace capacity data, facilitating permits. The executive gave cash (5万美元 and 30万元) as gratitude. This is bribery: giving money to state staff to obtain favorable treatment. The defendant is a corporate legal person (company) and its legal representative.
